semantic_checks.result: The forward map is exactly WithLp.toLp 2 [cos(theta)*X0-sin(theta)*X1, sin(theta)*X0+cos(theta)*X1, X2], in that coordinate order. The signs agree with multiplying X0+i*X1 by cos(theta)+i*sin(theta); this compatibility was checked algebraically, not claimed as a separate formal theorem in this module.

Position is EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 3). The norm proof compares nonnegative norm squares and expands the actual Euclidean square-sum norm; the remaining identity follows from cos(theta)^2+sin(theta)^2=1 times X0^2+X1^2. No coordinate sup norm or unproved matrix-isometry assumption is substituted.

The structure proves real additivity and real scalar compatibility coordinatewise. physicalAxisRotationLinear_neg_apply proves the negative-angle left inverse using actual trig parity and the same square-sum identity. The right inverse uses that theorem at -theta and double negation, after an explicit map-coercion change. The isometry equivalence packages this same linear map and inverse, not an unrelated abstract equivalence.

The whole-vector and three coordinate evaluation theorems are definitionally the actual map. physicalAxisRotation_axis fixes every vector [0,0,s] for arbitrary real s and theta; it imposes neither s=1 nor a unit-vector condition.

autoImplicit is false and all nine expanded final types match the source. Theta is an arbitrary real number, X is any Position, and s is any real number. No angle restriction, nonzero sine/cosine premise, regularity premise, or extra typeclass parameter was introduced.
